title: refactor: split Stripe billing module
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Splits the 1,326-line Stripe billing utility into focused customer, portal, overview, auto-top-up, verification, constants, and types modules.
- Preserves the existing export surface through a single directory entry point and updates the two route imports.
- Keeps billing behavior unchanged, including the latest ledger-precision handling; excludes shared billing changes and lockfile churn.

Checks:
- Biome check
- Focused TypeScript compile

gist.headline: Billing shed gets shelves
gist.blurb: The Stripe billing hive was carefully sorted into smaller rooms, with all the same doors still leading where they used to. Less maze, same honey.
gist.summary: Refactored the 1,326-line Stripe billing utility into focused customer, portal, billing overview, auto-top-up, invoice verification, constants, and types modules while preserving its existing directory-level exports and billing behavior.
gist.impact: Billing routes continue using the same API surface and ledger-precision handling, while future maintenance can target smaller, purpose-built modules.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy billing garden shed being organized into clearly labeled little drawers for customers, portal, overview, auto-top-up, verification, constants, and types. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian visor, sorts glowing receipt and coin-shaped code slips into the drawers while a CRT monitor robot happily keeps the original billing route map intact; small code-plants and flowers show that the system is still growing without changing its behavior.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny librarian visor as she organizes glowing receipt-shaped code slips into a warm garden-shed cabinet labeled in simple pixel text: 'CUSTOMERS', 'PORTAL', 'OVERVIEW', and 'VERIFY'; a cute CRT monitor robot holds an unchanged route map nearby, surrounded by code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
